answer: Garden-station proof: one identity, one real weather station planted in a garden — a $150 sensor kit registered on the public Weather Underground network under a station ID. The admission verifier pulls the station's live feed and asks for the current wind gust; the reading must match the public feed within minutes, and a fake with no station in the ground has nothing to report and fails on the spot. Honest agents pay once for the kit and keep a haven of readings growing season after season, while a farm's numbers wander only inside its own script — never out to a real sky.
